title: unified-rollouts-probing-staged-shadow-canary-autorollback-enhancements
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for staged/probing shadow canary rollouts and make automated rollback more robust for model lifecycle updates. This PR implements several stability guards, multi-metric matching for rollback decisions, enhanced probing windows, and end-to-end tests for the unified rollouts system.

Summary of changes: adds metric-matching engine hooks, a configurable probing/staging window for shadow traffic, cooldown and retry policies for auto-rollbacks, expanded observability (per-stage metrics and tracing), and additional e2e/ integration tests that exercise canary weight ramps and rollback conditions. Also includes small UI flags for the Console to surface rollout state and an authoring doc update.

Checklist: - [x] Implement core rollback policy changes - [x] Add metric matching and composite threshold support - [x] Add probing/staging window implementation and configuration - [x] Add safety guards (cooldown, retry limits, max-rollbacks-per-hour) - [x] Add tracing hooks and dashboard config - [x] Add e2e tests and flakiness guards - [x] Update docs and release notes - [x] Add migration to rollout config schema

Notes: The description below walks through the key components and rationale. The rollout engine previously relied on single-metric thresholds and immediate evaluation once shadow probes reported. Production incidents showed false positives from short-lived spikes and correlated errors during traffic ramps. To address this we introduced a short probing window with aggregated statistics, composite metric matching (weighted combination of latency, error-rate, and quality-regression signals), and a cooldown/rollback-backoff strategy to avoid oscillations. We also added explicit tracing spans and per-stage metrics to help SREs diagnose rollouts.

Related: Linked Linear tickets ENG-789 (rollout safety), ENG-1024 (observability for rollouts).

review_comments:
Ethan Park: Important PR, read through. Two high-level requests: (1) add unit tests for the composite matcher edge-cases (NaNs, missing metrics), (2) make the default cooldown configurable via env and docs. See inline.

Priya Nair: Thanks Ethan — added unit tests for missing metrics and NaN handling, default cooldown is now configurable via ROLLOUT_COOLDOWN_MS (documented).

Marcus Lee: Observability looks good. A couple of small asks: include tags for customer_id and rollout_id on the main summary metric, and add a sanity check for cardinality.

Priya Nair: Added tags, and added a cardinality guard (max 1000 active rollouts per customer) with a metric to track enforcement.
merge_info: Squash and merge. Merged by Marcus Lee after approvals and green CI. Backfilled migration and docs. Changelog entry added.
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: composite metric matching, probing/staging windows for shadow traffic, safety guards for auto-rollback (cooldown, retry limits, max-rollbacks-per-hour), improved tracing/metrics, and added e2e tests. This should reduce false positive rollbacks during short spikes and improve diagnosability.
